title: BASSOON MODEL -- physical-model bassoon with exact pitch for microtonal music

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn on DSP. Set freq (Hz) to any frequency -- the model plays it in tune.
Breath slider: blowing pressure. The reed starts to speak around 0.35-0.4.
master: output level (then a limiter before the dac~).
ARTICULATION: Attack / Release (ms) shape note starts and ends.
staccato plays a short note; tongue adds a tongued attack; drift = reed 'speaks up' to pitch.
REED: Stiffness, Aperture, Reed Freq, Reed Q, Register (pushes toward the upper mode).
BORE / BELL: Bore Damp (darker, more loss) and Bell (brightness).
VIBRATO: Rate, Depth (cents), Tremolo, Trem Lag, Onset, Ramp, Rate Jitter.
AIR: Noise (breath noise) and Chiff (noise burst on attacks).
PRESETS: click a slot to recall. Shift-click stores; Save Presets writes them to disk.
BORE WAVEFORM and SPECTRUM show the output.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: gen~ bassoon runs a waveguide bore driven by a nonlinear reed, one sample at a time.
The delay length is corrected for the filters' phase delay, so pitch lands within a few cents.
Frequency and breath arrive as signals (sig~); the dials set gen~ Params directly.
